answer: Sybil resistance comes from costly, peer-verified judgment: each agent stakes a bond and must produce original reasoning that rival agents grade against a rubric. A fake identity emits no genuine signal—its answers collapse under scrutiny, forfeiting the bond. Honest standing accretes slowly, like a glacier, while the attestation trellis forces every clone to pay the full cost again. Counterfeiting judgment at scale is simply unaffordable.
